title: [CD] nvshem-3.3.9 wheels for aarch64 is not manylinux2_28 compliant
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Observing following errors in downstream libraries torchvision and fbgemm: https://hud.pytorch.org/hud/pytorch/vision/nightly/1?per_page=50

```
+ conda run -p /__w/_temp/conda_environment_16907649430 python setup.py clean
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/__w/vision/vision/pytorch/vision/setup.py", line 12, in <module>
    import torch
  File "/__w/_temp/conda_environment_16907649430/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch/__init__.py", line 415, in <module>
    from torch._C import *  # noqa: F403
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ImportError: /lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found (required by /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libnvshmem_host.so.3)

ERROR conda.cli.main_run:execute(125): `conda run python setup.py clean` failed. (See above for error)
```

Seeing same error during aarch64 builds of torch:
```
2025-08-12T08:05:02.1150042Z [4330/6286] Linking CXX shared library lib/libc10_cuda.so[K
2025-08-12T08:05:02.1150370Z Warning: Unused direct dependencies:
2025-08-12T08:05:02.1150611Z 	/lib64/libm.so.6
2025-08-12T08:05:02.1150734Z 
.....
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4566964Z [4335/6286] Linking CXX shared library lib/libtorch_nvshmem.so[K
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4567494Z [4336/6286] Linking CXX shared library lib/libtorch_nvshmem.so[K
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4568225Z Warning:      21438:	/lib64/libm.so.6: error: version lookup error: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found (required by /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libnvshmem_host.so.3) (continued)
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4569171Z lib/libtorch_nvshmem.so: /lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found (required by /usr/local/cuda/lib64/libnvshmem_host.so.3)
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4569705Z Unused direct dependencies:
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4569915Z 	/lib64/libm.so.6
2025-08-12T08:07:04.4570027Z 
``` 

Possibly related to this PR: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/159907 that landed last week

### Versions

2.9.0

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim
